Verathon is a global medical device company focused on supporting customers by being their trusted partner, delivering high-quality products that endure over time and ensure clinical and economic utility.

Two areas where Verathon has significantly impacted patient care, and become the market leader in each, are bladder volume measurement and airway management.

The company’s BladderScan portable ultrasound and GlideScope video laryngoscopy & bronchoscopy systems effectively address unmet needs for healthcare providers and meaningfully raise the standard of care for patients.

Verathon , a subsidiary of Roper Technologies, is headquartered in Bothell, Washington, USA and has international subsidiaries in Canada, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit www.verathon.com.

Overview Be Part of Our Story You have the opportunity to bring your talents and develop your career in a rapidly growing and industry leading global medical device company in the airway management and single-use bronchoscopy device markets. We operate with a singular focus of empowering healthcare professionals to better serve their patients.

Our unique products and services help clinicians see the hidden realities of the human body, giving them insights they need to optimize patient care. For us, it starts with people: our team, our customers, and the patients they serve. Our innovation is based on finding new ways to offer simplicity where complexity exists.

We also look for opportunities to increase the velocity of patient care, ultimately providing solutions that improve and extend patients’ lives. Your Business GlideScope®: We developed the first video laryngoscope in 1999 and have since become the global market leader in video laryngoscope solutions.

Today we offer a broad range of tools that include visualization systems, single-use and reusable blades, stylets, stats and video batons to support a variety of workflows and specialties. BFlex™: We introduced BFlex bronchoscopes in 2019.

Since then, we have expanded the range of the BFlex product line to support a variety of patient types and procedures. BFlex single-use bronchoscopes combine the convenience and accessibility of single-use tools with the performance you expect from a reusable bronchoscope.

Paired with GlideScope, BFlex delivers the industry’s first total airway solution. Responsibilities How will you add Value?

Business Management: As a Verathon Sales Representative you will strategically manage the business in your territory to promote the Verathon GlideScope ® product line. You will execute sales strategies and techniques to realize sales opportunities identified in the Total Available Market (TAM) segmentation and analysis.

Be a Trusted Partner: You will generate new business and maintain existing business by understanding the needs, building rapport, and influence customers by delivering presentations to customers including creative solutions to their problems. You will manage the relationships with key customer stakeholders like Clinical Nursing, C-suite Executives, Administration, and BioMed contacts.

Achieve and Exceed Revenue Targets: You will generate a high volume of sales activity by in-person prospecting, product evaluations, proposal generation, customer presentations, and negotiations. You will forecast your business potential in order to ensure your sales pipeline supports the achievement of monthly, quarterly, and annual goals.

Understand your market: You will learn new industry and market information that allows you to adapt to shifts in market demand and strategy. You will engage in strategic business planning and execution and provide accurate and thorough sales reporting to leadership.

Industrieunternehmen in der Region Mittelland, die noch keine Kunden sind, identifizieren und aktiv akquirieren.

Bei CRIDEC steht Schutz an erster Stelle: Das ist der eigentliche Sinn unserer Arbeit. Wir handeln lieber vorausschauend, als Entwicklungen hinzunehmen, halten unsere Versprechen auch dann ein, wenn es schwierig wird, und gehen den Weg gemeinsam, mit gegenseitiger Wertschätzung.

Die AVY sucht eine Verkaufspersönlichkeit für die Deutschschweiz: eine Person, die langfristige Kundenbeziehungen aufbaut, die Weine aus Yvorne glaubwürdig vertritt und unsere Präsenz in Gastronomie, Hotellerie, Sommellerie und Fachhandel gezielt weiterentwickelt.
Über die AVY
Die AVY, Artisans Vignerons d’Yvorne, wurde 1902 gegründet und ist eine traditionsreiche Winzergenossenschaft im Waadtländer Chablais. Sie vinifiziert und vermarktet die Produktion ihrer 120 Mitglieder, hauptsächlich unter der renommierten Appellation Yvorne Chablais AOC.
Die AVY verbindet Tradition, Qualität und Modernität. Sie bewirtschaftet und valorisiert ein einzigartiges Terroir und produziert eine vielfältige Palette von Weinen: Chasselas, Rotweine, weisse Spezialitäten und zeitgemässe Kreationen. Die Qualität der AVY\-Weine wird regelmässig anerkannt und ausgezeichnet.
Die AVY ist in der Deutschschweiz bereits präsent und möchte ihre kommerzielle Entwicklung in diesem Markt gezielt verstärken, insbesondere in Gastronomie, Hotellerie, Sommellerie und Fachhandel.
Ihre Aufgabe
Ihre Aufgabe ist es, die kommerzielle Präsenz der AVY in der Deutschschweiz weiterzuentwickeln. Sie eröffnen neue Kundenbeziehungen, bauen bestehende und neue Kontakte langfristig aus und stärken die Sichtbarkeit sowie die Distribution der AVY\-Weine in einem anspruchsvollen und dynamischen Markt.
Sie verstehen sich als Botschafter/in der Weine aus Yvorne: Sie können Geschichte, Herkunft, Identität und Qualität der AVY\-Weine überzeugend vermitteln und zugleich mit den konkreten Bedürfnissen von Gastronomie, Sommellerie und Fachhandel verbinden.
Diese Rolle verlangt nicht nur Leidenschaft für Wein, sondern auch kommerzielle Disziplin: Akquise, konsequente Nachverfolgung, Portfolioaufbau, zuverlässige CRM\-Nutzung und die Fähigkeit, Vertrauen im Markt Schritt für Schritt aufzubauen.
Über den Verkauf hinaus übernehmen Sie eine beratende Rolle gegenüber den Kunden. Sie verstehen deren Positionierung, schlagen passende Sortimente vor, unterstützen die Weiterempfehlung und den Wiederverkauf der Weine und bringen relevante Marktinformationen zurück zur AVY.
Hauptverantwortlichkeiten
In dieser Funktion übernehmen Sie insbesondere folgende Aufgaben:
Weiterentwicklung der kommerziellen Präsenz der AVY in der Deutschschweiz bei HORECA, Sommellerie und Fachhandel.
Identifikation, Qualifikation und Ansprache neuer Kunden mit Potenzial, im Einklang mit der Positionierung und den Prioritäten der AVY.
Aufbau und Pflege langfristiger Beziehungen zu Restaurateuren, Hoteliers, Sommeliers, Vinotheken, Fachhändlern und weiteren kommerziellen Partnern.

Übersetzung der Eigenschaften eines Weins in konkreten Nutzen für den Kunden: Weinkarte, Sortiment, Preispositionierung, Marge, Gästeerlebnis, Identität des Hauses oder Wiederverkaufspotenzial.

Unterstützung der Kunden bei der Präsentation und dem Wiederverkauf der AVY\-Weine, unter anderem durch Degustationen, Sortimentsberatung, Verkaufsargumente und gezielte Aktionen.
Zuverlässige kommerzielle Nachverfolgung: Angebote, Follow\-ups, Verhandlungen, Bestellungen, Kundeninformationen und nächste Schritte.
Verlässliche Nutzung des CRM und digitaler Werkzeuge zur Dokumentation von Opportunitäten, Kundenportfolio und Marktinformationen.
Regelmässige Rückmeldung von Marktbeobachtungen: Kundenerwartungen, Konsumtrends, Wettbewerb, Preise, Einwände und Chancen.

Für diese Aufgabe suchen wir eine selbständige, strukturierte und resultatorientierte Persönlichkeit mit echtem Interesse an Wein, Menschen und langfristigen Geschäftsbeziehungen.
Sie hören zuerst zu, bevor Sie verkaufen. Sie möchten den Kunden, seinen Betrieb, sein Sortiment, seine Zwänge und seine Ziele verstehen. Sie können Vertrauen aufbauen, glaubwürdig beraten und ein Weinhaus authentisch vertreten.

**Help organisations stay one step ahead of cyber threats **
Cyber attacks are no longer a question of if, but when. While prevention remains important, organisations increasingly rely on their ability to detect threats early, respond effectively, and recover quickly.
At Deloitte, we help some of Switzerland's largest and most critical organisations build and transform their cyber defence capabilities. From designing Cyber Defence Centres and Security Operations Centres to improving incident response, deploying security technologies, and exploring AI-enabled security operations, we help our clients strengthen their resilience against an ever-evolving threat landscape.
If you are passionate about cyber defence, enjoy solving complex challenges, and want to work at the intersection of strategy, operations, and technology, this is the opportunity for you.
**How you can make an impact **
As a Cyber Detect & Respond Advisor, you will work alongside experienced cyber professionals to help clients prepare for, detect, respond to, and recover from cyber threats and attacks.

* Assess and improve cyber defence capabilities, including Security Operations Centres (SOC), Cyber Defence Centres (CDC), Incident Response, Threat Intelligence, Threat Hunting, and Vulnerability Management
* Help clients design practical and effective cyber defence strategies, operating models, governance structures, and transformation roadmaps
* Design, implement, configure, and optimise cyber defence technologies such as SIEM, EDR, NDR, Threat Intelligence, and Vulnerability Management platforms
* Support the development of detection use cases, monitoring capabilities, automation workflows, and security operations processes
* Conduct cyber defence assessments, maturity reviews, and benchmarking exercises to identify improvement opportunities
* Support incident response readiness activities, including playbook development, tabletop exercises, and crisis preparedness initiatives
* Evaluate emerging technologies and help clients understand how innovations such as AI-powered security operations can enhance detection and response capabilities
* Work closely with specialists across Deloitte to deliver integrated cyber security solutions that create measurable value for clients
* Contribute to business development, thought leadership, and the continued growth of Deloitte's Detect & Respond practice

We are looking for curious and motivated professionals who combine technical expertise with a desire to make a real impact. You bring:
* Approximately 5+ years of professional experience in cyber security, cyber defence, security operations, incident response, threat intelligence, cyber engineering, or a related field
* A passion for helping organisations prepare for and respond to cyber threats
* Practical experience in one or more areas such as Security Operations, Incident Response, Threat Intelligence, Threat Hunting, Detection Engineering, Vulnerability Management, Digital Forensics, or Cyber Defence
* Familiarity with technologies such as Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, XSIAM, CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender, SentinelOne, Cortex XDR, EDR, NDR, SIEM, or similar solutions
* Understanding of modern threat actors, attack techniques, and cyber defence best practices
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders
* Curiosity, drive, and a desire to continuously learn and develop

* Experience working in a Security Operations Centre (SOC), Cyber Defence Centre (CDC), CSIRT, or Incident Response team
* Exposure to AI-enabled security operations, security automation, detection engineering, or threat validation
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, GCIH, GCIA, GCFA, SC-200, AZ-500, or equivalent
* University degree in a relevant field (Bachelor's or Master's)
* Fluent English; German and/or French are an advantage
**Your team**
You will join a diverse, international, and highly collaborative team of cyber security professionals who are passionate about helping organisations strengthen their resilience against cyber threats.
What makes our team different is the opportunity to work across the full cyber defence lifecycle. One day you may be helping a client define their future Cyber Defence Centre strategy, the next designing security monitoring capabilities, improving incident response processes, or supporting the implementation of leading security technologies.
We believe that great careers are built through challenging work, continuous learning, and strong support. You will benefit from hands-on experience, dedicated mentoring, professional certifications, and collaboration with experts across Deloitte's global network.
Most importantly, we foster an open and inclusive culture where people are encouraged to bring new ideas, challenge the status quo, and shape the future of cyber defence.
Ready to make an impact?
Join us and help organisations build the capabilities they need to detect threats faster, respond smarter, and emerge stronger from cyber incidents. Your next challenge starts here.

About Dutchie
Founded in 2017, Dutchie is a comprehensive technology platform powering dispensary operations, while providing consumers with safe and easy access to cannabis.

Dutchie aims to further support the positive societal change the cannabis industry brings to the world through wellness benefits, social justice, and empowering local communities through tax revenue.

Powering thousands of dispensaries across 40+ markets throughout the United States and Canada, Dutchie is the leading technology company in the cannabis space and was named in Fast Company’s 10 Most Innovative Companies in North America and listed two years in a row on LinkedIn’s Top 50 Startups.
Dutchie has raised over $600M in funding to date, backed by D1 Capital Partners, Tiger Global, Dragoneer, DFJ Growth, Thrive Capital, Howard Schultz, Snoop Dogg’s Casa Verde Capital, Gron Ventures, members of the founding team at DoorDash, Kevin Durant’s Thirty Five Ventures, and other notable angel investors.
About This Job
As a Business Development Representative on our outbound team, you'll find and open doors with dispensaries that haven't discovered Dutchie yet. You'll build target lists, run sequences, and start conversations that turn into qualified meetings for our Account Executives and Account Managers.

To succeed here, you'll need to be curious about the businesses you're prospecting into, resourceful when a first attempt doesn't land, and genuinely energized by the grind of top-of-funnel outbound — the volume, the research, the follow-up.
This role sits on a strong, growing sales team and comes with real coaching and mentorship as you ramp. You'll need to move comfortably across systems and adapt quickly as our outbound motion takes shape — prioritizing the accounts and activities that create the most pipeline. Your success will be rooted in consistent activity, sharp messaging, and a coachable mindset that keeps improving week over week.

Outbound Prospecting: Build and work target account lists across U.S. dispensaries, using state, license status, and market maturity to prioritize who you reach out to and when.
Multi-Channel Outreach: Run cold and warm outreach across call, email, and social, using the Dutchie Revenue Playbook to deliver consistent, proof-point-driven messaging that resonates with dispensary owners and operators.
Meeting Generation: Book qualified meetings for Account Executives and Account Managers, and manage a clean handoff so context and momentum aren't lost.
Pipeline Hygiene: Log activity, disposition, and source data accurately in HubSpot and Salesforce (Legacy and Greenpath), giving leadership reliable visibility into pipeline health.
Performance & Coaching: Hit weekly and monthly activity and meetings-booked targets, and show up for regular 1:1 coaching and Gong call reviews to keep sharpening your messaging and objection handling.
Market Intelligence: Share what you're hearing in the field — competitive signals, regional trends, buying triggers — so the team can keep refining how we target and message.

1+ years of experience in a sales, BDR/SDR, or outbound prospecting role, preferably within B2B SaaS or tech.
A track record of hitting activity and pipeline-generation targets in a metrics-driven environment.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to cold call and the ability to write outreach that doesn't sound templated.
Comfort working in a CRM (Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar) and following a defined process for logging activity and disposition.
A coachable, growth-oriented mindset — you want mentorship from a strong team and a path toward Account Executive or Account Management.
Genuine curiosity about the cannabis retail industry and a willingness to learn the regulatory nuances that shape how dispensaries buy.
Organizational skills to manage a high volume of accounts and outreach without losing attention to detail.

Souhaitez-vous mettre en œuvre des solutions dans des projets nationaux et internationaux ? Devenir membre d'une équipe jeune ? Allier l'esprit start-up à une expérience classique de conseil ? Être déployé chez des clients de premier ordre ? Mettre en œuvre des idées innovantes ? Travailler en étroite collaboration avec la direction ? Suivre votre grande passion pour le succès et le savoir ? Découvrir de nouveaux horizons ?
Alors rejoignez notre équipe et postulez pour le poste de Consultant en gestion informatique.
## Qui sommes-nous ? ##
BaXian AG est une société de conseil opérant à l'international, spécialisée dans la sécurité informatique, la sécurité gérée, la transformation et le risque & conformité. Nos clients sont des entreprises de renommée mondiale et leaders dans leur secteur.
## Que vous attendons-nous ? ##
Chez nous, vous travaillez activement avec des clients nationaux et internationaux et assumez la responsabilité de la planification, de la mise en œuvre et du déploiement de vos propres projets.

Vous conseillez stratégiquement et techniquement de grandes entreprises en matière de sécurité informatique et développez des concepts de solutions innovants.

De plus, vous obtenez un aperçu approfondi des domaines du développement commercial, des fusions-acquisitions côté acheteur, ainsi que du développement et de l'entretien des contacts clients et de l'élaboration de stratégies de vente.
## Qui recherchons-nous ? ##
Nous recherchons des diplômés universitaires (h/f) en sciences économiques ou en informatique de gestion avec au moins 2 ans d'expérience professionnelle dans les domaines du conseil et de la gestion de projet. Outre une forte pensée entrepreneuriale et une bonne compréhension des processus, des compétences analytiques, un travail orienté solutions, la résistance au stress, la créativité, l'engagement et la connaissance des normes informatiques (ITIL, COBIT, ISO 27000) sont indispensables.
Vous vous identifiez à notre mentalité et souhaitez vous dépasser avec nous ? Alors envoyez-nous votre candidature incluant un CV avec photo, une lettre de motivation, tous les diplômes académiques et professionnels regroupés dans un seul fichier au format PDF.

pour le secteur : toute la Suisse romande ainsi que Berne jusqu’à Bâle
